notes.title: We've Escaped Early Access with Chapter 4!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Everyone, [/h1]

The long-awaited day has arrived… [h2] Chapter 4 is here.[/h2]

Today I'm excited to get to announce that [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/b] has left Early Access, and you can play all four chapters [u]right now[/u]!  It’s been a long time coming and I hope it has been worth it.  I’m thrilled to get it out to you all and conclude this story.

By the time you’re reading this, the game should have automatically installed the chapter 4 update, or have at least started installing it for your gaming pleasure.  Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=yFyreS7PLWY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Chapter 4: Beginning of the End (Preview Update)
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

It’s been some time since I gave any info on the fourth and final chapter of [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/b], so today I’ll be getting you all caught up.

On June 11th I did my first full playthrough test of the entire game, and luckily nothing blew up!  For the rest of that month, I did a bit more testing, fixed some bugs, and added the main text translations to the chapter.  The original plan was to release the game earlier in the summer, but due to some delays, we had to push the release date back a bit, so we apologize for the wait.  It’s certainly been longer than I hoped for, but hopefully, you all can hang in there a little longer.

At the time of writing this, I’m just waiting on some playtesting results, that way I can get as many bugs fixed as possible and eliminate any goofy mistakes I might have made during development.  Once I get these results all I need to do is make a few changes, fixes, and optimizations, and then it’ll be ready to launch.

In the meantime, I’ve been spending time researching some more of the interworking of the indie game industry, and have been experimenting with some different game ideas that I might develop fully after My Beautiful Paper Smile has been fully launched.  While MBPS has been in limbo for a few months, I’ve certainly been staying busy and I can’t wait to share more about my upcoming projects soon (follow [url=https://twitter.com/TwoStarGames]@TwoStarGames[/url] on Twitter for updates!).

Now that I’ve got all the status update stuff out of the way, here are some cool screenshots from chapter 4.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/1626783bd567bfe3d6ed57fdf4c46088d77b68a6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/39b5ab912930c1cbbc26a9310f129df2df31e9c4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/20d71d81f0306398eeec5d2f546b5297d7af32bc.jpg[/img]


Hope you all are excited to play the conclusion to this game because I can’t wait to get it out there for you.

Until next time!  Keep smiling :)

notes.title: Behind-the-Masks: Chapter 3 Development Continues
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

Today I get to share a little bit about what I’ve been working on for [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile: Chapter 3![/b]  I’ve been in full development for this chapter for a little over a month, and I’m thrilled to say that things are coming along really smoothly.  Before the game launched in Early Access in June, I was able to program some new systems that are helping development immensely.  For example, in the past it could easily take over an hour to add a single conversation between a couple characters, but I made a new dialogue system that allows me to add conversations in just a few minutes.  It’s been great!

So with those improvements, I’ve been able to get a lot done on the third chapter.  Here are a few goodies to look forward to.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/efsJZwcO3X9sQnfA71/giphy.gif[/img]

For starters, in the second chapter I started experimenting with some larger, more open environments to explore.  A lot of people really enjoyed this change, so this is something I’m trying to continue in Chapter 3.

Another big addition that this will allow for is patrolling enemies.  This is something that I originally wanted to include in the first chapter, but because of the way I built the levels, there just wasn’t any way to make it possible.  This is why I instead used the security cameras.  So while there won’t be cameras in Chapter 3, you will see a much more interactive world, and better stealth system.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/j6TQrtz1oGYfD11UMx/giphy.gif[/img]

As well as working on the third chapter, I’ve recently put out a small patch update to address some bugs in the first two chapters.  You can read the changelog below:

[u]Version 5.0.1d[/u]

-Fixed bugged cranks that would prevent beating the second chapter's boss.
-Added “F” as a shortcut key to equip and unequip the “Life” item.
-Optimized package size.
-Fixed issue of players spawning in the air after exiting buildings.

That’s about it for today's post!  Lot’s of cool stuff is coming, so be sure to keep updated.  

[b]Until next time! Keep smiling :)[/b]

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

It’s been a few weeks since we launched [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/b] into Early Access, and today I wanted to share with you what our plan is for the game over the next year or so.  

We’ll be releasing periodic patches to address smaller issues and bugs with the game, but will also be making a couple of larger updates to mark major milestones in its development.  The biggest changes in these updates will be the addition of the last two chapters, but along with the updates for each chapter, we’ll be adding some other features and improvements as well.

The first major update will be the [b]Chapter 3 Update[/b], coming in [b]Late 2020[/b]!  
Here’s a list of the main things to look forward to in this update:

[list]
[*] The complete third chapter (hence why this is titled the “Chapter 3 Update”)
[*] Support for multiple new languages
[*] (Hopefully) Controller support
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/ea5f985e2bab3b4626a22fcddcec5be382efcd40.png[/img]


The next major update will be when we transition from Early Access and will be our Full Launch Update, coming by [b]Summer 2021[/b]!  Here’s what we have planned for the full launch:

[list]
[*] The fourth and final chapter of the game
[*] A total of 12 supported languages
[*] Mac port
[*] Controller support (for sure this time)
[*] As many bug fixes as are humanly possible
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34567924/0e8fec23bb5adc6c582edbbb77a49c7be150909b.png[/img]

There you have it.  The plan is pretty straight forward at the moment, but we'll be posting about our progress and finer details as things come along.  Also, remember that your input matters!  Throughout the development of the game, be sure to let us know what you’d like to see changed, fixed, or improved upon.  I’m listening to whatever you have to say, and everything, at the very least, comes into consideration.

Thanks for reading, and hopefully this gives you a better idea of what we have in store for [b]My Beautiful Paper Smile[/b].

Until next time! Keep smiling :) Don't forget to join our Discord or follow our Social Media for more updates along the way.
